name: Sanna Virtanen
bio:
Sanna's career began in general HR before her passion for motorsport led her to Anderson Racing. She holds a Master's degree in Human Resources Management from the University of Helsinki. Her transition to motorsport was fueled by a desire to apply her HR expertise in a fast-paced, competitive environment. Sanna is deeply committed to fostering a positive and productive work environment, valuing open communication and employee well-being.

At Anderson Racing, Sanna is responsible for overseeing all aspects of HR, including recruitment, training, employee relations, and performance management. She believes in a data-driven approach, using analytics to identify areas for improvement in employee satisfaction and retention. She's known for her proactive approach, always seeking ways to improve the team's overall performance through effective HR strategies. Her commitment to ethical and fair practices sets her apart in the high-pressure world of motorsport.

Sanna's ambition extends beyond simply managing HR; she aims to be a strategic partner, contributing to the team's success on and off the track. She is determined to create a culture of excellence at Anderson Racing, where every team member feels valued and empowered to achieve their full potential.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight blonde hair, usually tied back in a neat ponytail.
physical.description: Sanna is a slender woman with a focused, intelligent gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.
